title: Structural insights into the Bre1-Lge1 and RNF20/RNF40-WAC interactions critical for H2B ubiquitination.
authors: Shi, Meng; Wang, Xuejie; Zhang, Hang; Wen, Yajiao; Liu, Qianqian; Chen, Pu; Chen, Xuefeng; Xiang, Song
one_liner_zh: 该文解析Bre1-Lge1与RNF20/RNF40-WAC复合物结构，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA互作，且用AlphaFold建模但无TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: The mono-ubiquitination of the histone protein H2B (H2BUb1) has important functions in transcription, DNA repair, and other chromatin-related processes. The reaction is catalyzed by Bre1 and the homologous RNF20/RNF40 complex in the budding yeast and human cells, respectively, and is promoted by their respective interaction partners, Lge1 and WAC. The mechanism of the Bre1-Lge1 and RNF20/RNF40-WAC interactions is poorly understood. Here, we present the crystal structure of the Bre1-Lge1 complex and an AlphaFold predicted structure model of the RNF20/RNF40 complex bound with WAC, as well as in vitro and in vivo experiments to assess the interaction mechanism and function. Our study revealed extensive Bre1-Lge1 and RNF20/RNF40-WAC interfaces and a structural homology shared by these interfaces, but completely different sets of key electrostatic interactions at these interfaces that are crucial for the binding and encode the binding specificity. We further found that these interactions play critical roles in the Bre1-catalyzed H2BUb1 reaction and processes it regulates. Our data provide insights into the mechanism of the Bre1-Lge1 and RNF20/RNF40-WAC interactions.
abstract_zh: 组蛋白H2B的单泛素化（H2BUb1）在转录、DNA修复及其他染色质相关过程中具有重要功能。该反应分别由芽殖酵母中的Bre1和人类细胞中的同源RNF20/RNF40复合物催化，并受其各自相互作用伙伴Lge1和WAC的促进。Bre1-Lge1和RNF20/RNF40-WAC相互作用的机制尚不清楚。在此，我们展示了Bre1-Lge1复合物的晶体结构、AlphaFold预测的RNF20/RNF40复合物与WAC结合的结构模型，以及体外和体内实验，以评估相互作用机制和功能。我们的研究揭示了Bre1-Lge1和RNF20/RNF40-WAC界面的广泛性，以及这些界面共有的结构同源性，但关键静电相互作用在这些界面上完全不同，这些相互作用对结合至关重要并编码结合特异性。我们进一步发现，这些相互作用在Bre1催化的H2BUb1反应及其调控过程中发挥关键作用。我们的数据为Bre1-Lge1和RNF20/RNF40-WAC相互作用的机制提供了见解。
